title: ar500armor.com
description: Phoenix, Arizona. The company sells body armor to police officers, firefighters, military personnel, and ordinary civilians — under the trade name AR500 Armor, the legal entity Armored Republic LLC, and the holding company Armored Republic Holdings. Its website carries a lofty slogan about "protecting lives"; its catalog features Level IV plates sold to federal agencies; its client list includes the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), the Department of Homeland Security, the United States Secret Service, and the United Nations.
